speaker: character
text: The council just cut our grant in half. We can't pay for the room or the lunches, and the deposit is due Friday. I think we have to cancel.

speaker: candidate
text: How did we not see this coming? Somebody should have checked the budget earlier.

speaker: character
text: So what do we do? We have half the money and seven days.

speaker: candidate
text: Fine. We run it for thirty pupils instead of sixty and make it one day.

speaker: character
text: If we can't do everything, what do we protect?

speaker: candidate
text: Let's ask the team what they think matters most and go with the vote.

speaker: character
text: Sixty kids signed up and we have thirty seats. How do we choose?

speaker: candidate
text: First come, first served, and we tell everyone why. That's the fairest.

speaker: character
text: Okay. The deposit is due Friday. What exactly do we do before then?

speaker: candidate
text: Leave it to me, I'll handle all of it myself. It's faster.

speaker: character
text: The university room fell through. All we can get is a small room for twenty people. Now what?

speaker: candidate
text: I'll find another room tonight, whatever it takes. We'll squeeze all thirty in somehow.
